title: Lakehouse: full health (MinIO EC + Nessie + Spark + ZK + PG repl)
description: Runs `nexus health lakehouse`. Probes MinIO live + cluster + EC drives, the Nessie object-store + catalog checks, the Spark ALIVE master + aliveworkers, the ZooKeeper quorum, the iceberg-pg streaming replication, and the VRRP VIP. On the healed tier all probes are green.

observe.what: minio 4/4 live + cluster 200 + 4 drives ok; nessie-config 2/2 + nessie-objectstore 2/2 UP; spark ALIVE + 3/3 workers; ZK 1 leader + 2 followers; iceberg-pg 1 streaming standby; VIP bound; overall green

whatProves: LakehouseAdapter.HealthAsync rolls MinIO + Nessie + Spark + ZooKeeper + iceberg-pg replication into one report. The nessie-objectstore probe surfaces the cross-tier S3 trust (DOWN under a CA split, UP once the tier is on the same Vault root as MinIO).
